_comment: This file registers the OUT-OF-SAMPLE phase of experiment 'e1-spy-monday'.
It is deliberately SEPARATE from farm/experiments/e1-spy-monday.yaml: that
config was pre-registered 2026-07-18 and already has result rows, so its
hash is frozen and adding an 'oos_start' key to it would trip
farm/experiment.py's immutability check. The backtest phase (in-sample +
locked holdout) is owned by the YAML; the forward phase is owned by this
file. Both write to experiment_results under the SAME experiment_id and the
SAME params_hash (the YAML's hash, recorded below) — the forward rows are
distinguished by partition = 'oos:<date>' and a non-null trade_date.
Once a forward result row exists, THIS FILE IS FROZEN TOO. Do not edit.
hypothesis: SPY shows a positive Monday intraday drift: buying the Monday open and selling the same Monday's close earns a small positive average per-trade return. Null hypothesis: mean Monday open->close return <= 0 net of costs.

params.note: Same-bar open->close on calendar Mondays. Holiday Mondays have no bar and are simply skipped (no trade that week). No signal or filter reads any data at/after the Monday open, so there is no look-ahead beyond the experiment's own registered open->close mechanics.

expectation.source: trading-engine-design.md §12.3 experiment backlog (E1, approved/pre-registered 2026-07-16). The +10%/yr gross figure is the decayed prior, NOT a fitted value.

oos_start_note: Forward window starts with the paper league (§12.3). The first out-of-sample Monday is the first Monday on or after 2026-07-17, i.e. 2026-07-20. Everything before this date is BACKTEST CONTEXT ONLY and never enters the out-of-sample record.

cost_model.spy_tier: SPY's 60-bar median dollar volume is ~$36bn, far above the $50M top tier, so half_spread_bps = 5 -> per_side_bps = 10.0 -> ROUND-TRIP 20.0 bp
cost_model.application: buy at open*(1 + s/1e4), sell at close*(1 - s/1e4); s recomputed per Monday from bars STRICTLY BEFORE that Monday (median_dollar_vol uses date < as_of), so the cost itself carries no look-ahead.
cost_model.registered_note: The frozen YAML registered a 3bp round-trip assumption (~1.5%/yr, the §12.3 cost anchor). The forward record uses the LEAGUE's own fill model instead — 20bp round-trip, ~6.6x stricter — because the forward test must be at least as honest as the paper league it runs beside. Both are reported; the kill test uses the league model.

kill_criterion.rule: after 40 out-of-sample Mondays, if mean <= 0 OR t-stat < 0.5 the strategy is KILLED
kill_criterion.verbatim_design: Kill: after 40 out-of-sample Mondays, mean <= 0 or t < 0.5 - no re-optimization.
kill_criterion.series_note: §12.3 does not state which series the kill test reads. Registered here, BEFORE the evidence exists, as NET at the league cost model - the conservative reading, consistent with the registration framing 'decayed expectation ~ +10%/yr gross vs ~1.2-1.5%/yr costs' (i.e. the edge must survive costs). Gross and 3bp-net statistics are published alongside so any reader can apply either reading.

backtest_context.note: Report-only. Mondays in [oos_start - 2y, oos_start) computed identically, shown for context. NEVER written to experiment_results as forward rows and NEVER mixed into the out-of-sample statistics.
